datasets.title: Synthetic District Demonstration Fixture (Example Only)
datasets.known_limitations: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE ONLY: Not real economic data; isolated for automated test suites.

datasets.title: Census of India 2011 - Primary Census Abstract (Tamil Nadu)
datasets.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)
datasets.known_limitations: Decennial baseline from 2011. Pre-dates subsequent district bifurcations (6 new districts formed after 2011: Tenkasi, Chengalpattu, Tirupathur, Ranipet, Kallakurichi, Mayiladuthurai).

datasets.title: Ministry of MSME - Udyam Registration District Statistics (Tamil Nadu)
datasets.publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
datasets.known_limitations: Measures formalized registrations on the Udyam portal. Does not capture unregistered informal enterprises. Aggregated to the 32 parent district baseline.

datasets.title: RBI & SLBC Tamil Nadu - District Credit and Deposit Statistics
datasets.publisher: Reserve Bank of India & State Level Bankers' Committee (SLBC) Tamil Nadu
datasets.license: Reserve Bank of India Public Data Dissemination
datasets.known_limitations: Includes Scheduled Commercial Banks only; cooperative and informal credit not covered. CD ratio in metro districts reflects corporate credit concentration.

datasets.title: Department of Economics & Statistics - District Road Infrastructure (Tamil Nadu)
datasets.publisher: Department of Economics and Statistics (DoES), Government of Tamil Nadu
datasets.license: Government of Tamil Nadu Open Statistical Publication
datasets.known_limitations: Road density calculated based on surfaced roads maintained by Highways and Rural Local Bodies. Forest roads and private corridors excluded.

datasets.title: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) Annual Report (Candidate Source)
datasets.known_limitations: MoSPI PLFS published reports suppress district-level estimates due to survey sample size. District indicators require unit-level microdata extraction (DDI manual workflow).
